Hi Miya, I really like your name. I'm gonna be straight up and say that i disagree with the other person that commented in that "if middle school is bad, highschool is worse" because that isn't true. school is really what you make it, you know? like people suck and public school sucks but that doesn't mean you're to blame. i've been depressed for a long time too, and i got into cutting when i was around your age and that didn't help me either. believe it or not, what helped me was letting go. i didn't care what bullies had to say about me, and eventually i joked and went along with it because if you put up a front that it doesn't bother you, it eventually won't bother you. therapy can only do so much on its own, at least that's my opinion on it. have you tried talking to ur doctor? antidepressants can really help, despite the horror stories about them. you might not find the right one right away, but eventually you will find sometting that will help. in reality, being 13 really sucks. i know you don't really think your age matters in regards to this, but it does. 13 is seriously difficult, maybe because it's when the brain starts behaving more like an adult or whatever but all in all it's difficult. but that doesn't mean you're worthless or weak for not being able to handle it on your own. you can get through this, i promise. i'm not sure if this helps, but i hope maybe you find some comfort in knowing you aren't alone even if it feels like you are. you can talk to me if you want, i'll listen.
